title: Pattern Headings: Types of Educational Institutions
summary: Pattern-heading list for types of educational institutions (pattern heading Universities and colleges). Subdivisions are free-floating under headings for types of schools and educational institutions at all levels, but not under Schools or under names of individual institutions (H 1151). Legal subdivisions may be further subdivided per H 1154.5 and classes-of-persons subdivisions per H 1100.
validation_rules: Subdivisions on this list are free-floating under headings for types of schools and educational institutions at all levels (e.g. *Agricultural colleges*; *Boarding schools*; *Community colleges*; *Elementary schools*; *Schools of architecture*; *Women's colleges*). (H 1151.5, Types of headings covered)
Do not use this list free-floating under the heading *Schools* or under names of individual educational institutions (those follow H 1151). (H 1151.5, Types of headings covered)
A listed subdivision may be used free-floating if appropriate and no conflict exists in the subject authority file. (H 1151.5, Conflicts)
Only subdivisions marked (May Subd Geog) may be followed by a geographic subdivision. (H 1151.5, list)

Legal subdivisions (`--Law and legislation`, `--Administration--Law and legislation`, `--Admission--Law and legislation`, `--Auditing--Law and legislation`, `--Entrance examinations--Law and legislation`, `--Examinations--Law and legislation`, `--Finance--Law and legislation`) may be further subdivided per H 1154.5. (H 1151.5, note 1)
`--Alumni and alumnae`, `--Employees`, `--Faculty`, and `--Professional staff` may be further subdivided by subdivisions for classes of persons (H 1100). (H 1151.5, note 2)
`--Examinations--[subject]` takes the name of a subject in place of [subject]. (H 1151.5, list)

Form subdivisions on this list ($v `--Archives`, `--Chapel exercises`, `--Prayers`, `--Sermons`, and `--Curricula--Catalogs`, `--Entrance examinations--Study guides`) are valid LCSH; most may also be used as $x for works about the form. (H 1151.5, Note; H 1075 sec. 1.d)
[LC practice] If an exceptional variant form is retained, make a UF reference from the equivalent free-floating subdivision form (H 195); otherwise propose a change (H 193). (H 1151.5, Conflicts)

sections.heading: Types of headings covered by the pattern
sections.text: Headings for types of schools and educational institutions at all levels. Examples: *Agricultural colleges*; *Boarding schools*; *Community colleges*; *Elementary schools*; *Schools of architecture*; *Women's colleges*. The category does not include the heading *Schools* or headings for names of individual educational institutions, which are covered by H 1151.

sections.heading: Conflicts
sections.text:
Any subdivision listed here can be used as a free-floating subdivision under any heading belonging to the category if it is appropriate and no conflict exists in the subject authority file. Subject authority records may exist for headings employing variant phrases or subdivisions equivalent to subdivisions on this list.

LC practice: If an exceptional variant form is to be retained, make a UF reference from the equivalent free-floating subdivision form following the procedures in H 195 if the reference does not yet exist. Otherwise, submit a proposal to change the variant form along with all bibliographic records requiring correction following the procedures in H 193.

Note: Most form subdivisions coded $v in this list may also be used as topical subdivisions coded $x when assigned to works about the form (see H 1075, sec. 1.d.).
